description: metal : remove mul_mm_id amax rescaling ( #30924 ) The src1 power-of-two rescale in kernel_mul_mm_id is superseded by the per expert-token amax scaling done in the compute graph (ref: #30861 ), which keeps the MoE down-projection activations within f16 range before the op runs. Drop the two-stage reduction kernels, their scratch buffer and the GGML_PREC_F32 dispatch added in #26223 , as well as the test cases that drive MUL_MAT_ID src1 out of f16 range. description: llama : deny -sm tensor for arches with moe amax rescaling ( #31081 ) The amax POOL_1D reduction spans the whole matmul row, so a device cannot compute it from an axis-0 split. Drop that case and deny -sm tensor for the arches which build the amax graph, see [TAG_MOE_AMAX_SCALE].
